title: Ryan Poles says Bears aren't adopting 'F them picks' mindset with Jeffery Simmons trade, DT's impact on culture factored into deal

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Ryan Poles says Bears aren't adopting 'F them picks' mindset with Jeffery Simmons trade, DT's impact on culture factored into deal
sources.description: Chicago sent the Tennessee Titans 2027 and 2028 first-round picks, along with a 2027 fourth-round pick, in exchange for the 3-time All-Pro and a 2028 fifth-round pick.
